subject: Flexible credits request for "Data & Models" community series

From: OpenML Labs <ops@openmllabs.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 May 2025 16:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: flexible community credits for 'Data & Models' series

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the new streaming latency improvements look great. We're running a week-long community workshop series (Data & Models) the week of June 9 and want to offer attendees a low-friction path to try Redwood for small projects.

Can Redwood provide:
- 50 single-use promo codes (redeemable for a 2-week trial, no CC)
- Ability to extend redemption window by 2 weeks after the event (we sometimes push signups)
- A short SOW or co-marketing note so we can list Redwood as a sponsor in the event page (we need the language for our promo kit)

We have limited budget for paid trials so if you can make a subset of codes restricted to a smaller compute quota that would be ideal. Attached: a proposed co-marketing SOW (MAP_SOW.pdf) and a short event brief.

Our point of contact: Charlotte Reed (charlotte@devcon.io) — she's helping with logistics.

Appreciate any guidance and next steps.

Best,
Sam Ortega
Partnerships | OpenML Labs

Forwarding OpenML's ask — low-risk partner credit for a community workshop. Quick summary of what they're requesting:
- 50 promo codes (2-week trial/no CC)
- Option to lengthen redemption window by +14 days
- Small co-marketing SOW (attached to original email)

Proposed internal approach:
- Approve 30 full 2-week trials + 20 quota-limited trials (to keep unit economics predictable)
- Expiration: codes valid for 6 weeks from issue, with redemption window extension toggle for partners (manual)
- Tag activity to deal HS-34821 for tracking

Marissa — can Sales Ops generate the code batch and format (CSV stub) and confirm redemption caps?
Naomi — need finance sign-off for the promotional spend and GL tagging.
Stephanie — any compliance or KYC concerns for a public community distribution?

If we greenlight, I'll send the codes and a short sponsor blurb to OpenML.

Thanks,
